description: Experience the signature Alva workout. **Alva Sculpt** is a dynamic, full-body reformer class that blends athletic movement with the precision of Pilates. Expect flowing sequences and controlled resistance designed to build strength and muscular endurance, with options from your instructor to adjust the challenge as you go. New to the reformer? We recommend starting with Alva Foundation to learn the equipment and fundamentals.

Start here if you're new to the reformer. **Alva Foundation** is a guided, full-body class that teaches how the equipment works, including the springs and straps, along with alignment, breath, and core engagement. Your instructor explains each movement clearly and offers options along the way, so the pace feels clear and supported. It's the ideal place to learn the fundamentals, and a valued class for anyone who wants to refine their technique.

Refine your movement and elevate your practice. **Alva Progress** builds on the fundamentals with layered sequences, more complex movements, and dynamic transitions that call for focus, coordination, and control. Your instructor assumes familiarity with the reformer and basic alignment, so the class moves at a steady, confident pace. A thoughtful challenge for clients who already know the equipment and want to deepen their technique.

Turn up the energy with **Alva Cardio Jump**, our athletic reformer class built around the jumpboard. This low-impact class alternates cardio intervals with reformer strength and core work, so expect a brisk pace with bursts of effort and moments to recover. Intensity can be adjusted throughout, with guidance from your instructor. You'll be most comfortable if you already know the reformer basics.

description: Slow down and reconnect with your body. **Alva Stretch & Flow** is a restorative reformer class that combines stretching, mobility work, and light strengthening with mindful breathwork and gentle, flowing sequences. The pace is unhurried, with time to breathe and move with attention. Release tension, build range of motion, and finish feeling balanced and at ease. A wonderful complement to more active classes, and suitable for any experience level.

**Alva Lower Body & Core** is a focused reformer class targeting the glutes, hamstrings, quads, hips, and core through controlled resistance, stability work, and precise movement sequences. The pace is measured, with slow, deliberate movement that asks for concentration and steady effort, and your instructor offers options to modify exercises. Expect a challenging, targeted session that builds strength and balance. New to the reformer? We recommend starting with Alva Foundation to learn the equipment and fundamentals.
